name: PEMPO AI Discovery
author: PEMPO

sections.description:
Turn your existing WordPress content into AI-ready content in seconds—no edits required. Install PEMPO once, and every post and page becomes easier for AI systems like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Perplexity to find, understand, and cite accurately. You’ll also gain control over how your work appears in their answers, from citation style to the facts they highlight. PEMPO automatically adds structured schema markup and cleans up distracting elements so AI tools can recognize and cite your work accurately.

Key Features:
– Zero setup required – works instantly after activation
– Automatic AI optimization for every post and page
– Citation control – customize how your publication appears in AI responses
– Content filtering – removes promotional clutter that confuses AI systems
– FAQ detection – automatically finds and structures Q&A content
– Theme compatible – works with any WordPress design
– SEO plugin friendly – complements Yoast, RankMath, and others

How It Works for You:
PEMPO runs quietly in the background, adding invisible, structured metadata that AI can instantly read. That means when ChatGPT, Perplexity, or other LLMs encounter your posts, they see exactly who wrote it, when it was published, and what key points it contains—boosting your chances of being cited exactly how you want.

Technical Specs:
– Schema.org compliant JSON-LD markup
– Lightweight performance – no external requests or speed impact
– Semantic text chunking for precise AI citations
– Author credibility signals for trustworthiness scoring
– Fact-checking metadata to establish source reliability
– Compatible with existing SEO setups
sections.installation:
1. Install from WordPress Plugin Directory
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Optionally customize settings in Settings > PEMPO AI Discovery
  4. Done! Your content is now AI-optimized
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my site?

No. PEMPO is extremely lightweight with no external requests or render-blocking scripts.

Will this work with my current SEO setup?

Yes! PEMPO is designed to work alongside Yoast, RankMath, and other Search Engine Optimization plugins. Think of it as “SEO for AI” rather than traditional search engines.

How do I know it’s working?

View your page source and look for structured JSON-LD data in the head section. You can also test with Google’s Rich Results validator.

Can I customize citations?

Yes! Go to Settings > PEMPO AI Discovery to set your publication name, citation style (academic, journalism, web), and source credibility level.

What content gets filtered?

PEMPO automatically removes promotional widgets, newsletter signups, and ads that can confuse AI content analysis.

Where does the schema appear?

In the HTML head section of single post and page views, as a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag.

What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

GEO is the practice of optimizing content for AI-powered search engines and large language models. Unlike traditional SEO which targets Google rankings, GEO ensures your content gets cited and referenced by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI systems. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is a subset of GEO since it focuses on Q&A pairings.
